title: Four Oirats
capsule: The Four Oirats (Dörben Oirad) — the Choros, Torghut, Dörbet and Khoshut tribes — rose as the dominant western Mongol confederation in this 1402–1475 window under leaders like Toghan and his son Esen Taishi, who ruled through puppet Chinggisid khans, crushed a Ming army and captured the Zhengtong Emperor at Tumu in 1449, then claimed the khan title himself in 1453, only for Oirat unity to collapse after his assassination in 1455.
attestation: Boundaries from Seshat Cliopatria (Bennett et al., Scientific Data 2025; CC BY 4.0), digitized from standard historical atlases at ~0.07° resolution. Four Oirat territorial extent is largely conjectural steppe geography, reconstructed from Ming shilu records and Mongol chronicle sources; boundaries with the Northern Yuan and Ming frontier zones are approximate.
